editorial:
Imagine your world falling apart after your spouse asks for a divorce, and you just need a place to hide. That is exactly where you find Carey, a sweet guy who is totally lost. He turns to his best friends, Julie and Paul, hoping they have some magic advice for a happy marriage. You will quickly find out that their secret is way weirder than he expected because they have an open relationship. The vibe is light and funny, but it gets awkward fast as Carey tries to navigate this new world of rules and boundaries.

The acting is great and the pacing keeps you laughing as things spiral out of control. The best part is watching the chaos unfold when Carey makes a huge mistake and crosses a line he should have left alone. While some jokes might feel a bit over the top, it is a wild ride.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the secret affairs blow up in everyone's faces. Carey finally realizes that he cannot fix his life by copying others. He and Ashley have a heart-to-heart and decide to try again on their own terms. Meanwhile, Julie and Paul learn that their open marriage needs better boundaries to actually work. Everyone ends up more honest with each other, and the movie wraps up with a funny group dinner.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves awkward comedies and stories about relationship drama.
